Daily Mental Health Checklist

A once-a-day pass over the basics that hold a mood steady: food, water, movement, people, rest. Use it to see what you have already covered today and what is still missing.

Wellbeing · Self-Care · Habits · 8 items · once a day

The checklist

  • Check-in with your emotions — How am I feeling today?
  • Stay hydrated and nourished — Have I eaten and drunk enough water?
  • Move my body — Did I engage in any physical activity (stretching, walking, etc.)?
  • Connect with others — Did I interact with someone in a meaningful way?
  • Practice mindfulness — Did I pause and take deep breaths or meditate?
  • Limit social media/news exposure — Did I avoid excessive negative content?
  • Engage in an enjoyable activity — Did I do something I love?
  • Get adequate rest — Am I prioritizing sleep and relaxation?

Use this checklist Free account: tick items off and keep each day's record.

How to use it

Run through it once a day, honestly and without scoring yourself. A checklist is a way of noticing, not a test: an item you cannot tick is information about the day, not a verdict on you. Over a few weeks the pattern of what gets ticked and what does not says more than any single pass.

With a free Theraglee account the checklist remembers each pass, so you can look back. Without one, you can still read it here and keep your own copy.
